name: powerpages-traditional-site
description: Power Pages Traditional (non-code) site toolkit — noun-named pp-* skills for provisioning, building, editing, integrating, and securing Power Pages sites on the enhanced Dataverse data model (mspp_* tables + powerpagecomponent). Content via the Dataverse Web API: web pages, web templates, web files, content snippets, web link navigation, server logic, Liquid, Web API, web roles, table permissions, security headers/CSP, security review. Site & platform lifecycle via the pac pages / pac power-pages CLI: website provisioning, standard→enhanced data-model migration, download/upload (ALM), Bootstrap 3→5 migration, WAF/firewall, and cache flush. The traditional-site counterpart to Microsoft's code-site plugin.
